newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital sells 2.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital sells 2.5 mln shares.

text.p: Security Capital Pacific Trust said Friday it sold 2.5 million common shares at $22.50 per share in a secondary offering.
As a result of the offering, the company said it will have 79.2 million shares outstanding.
The company said it would use the roughly $54.3 million net proceeds from the offering to repay borrowings under its line of credit and short-term borrowing agreement.
Security Pacific Capital is a real estate developer specializing in garden apartments in the western United States.
